title: CODAP Arbor Calibration Dataset v2
description: Frame-level behavior indicator dataset. All labels are step_inherited_indicator unless explicitly human_adjudicated. Absolute paths are prohibited.

label_policy.const: step_inherited_indicator — NOT gold-standard. Labels propagated from expert step alignments via nearest-step matching. Independent adjudication not performed.

split_role.description: Role in the leakage-safe split plan

frame_image_path.description: Repo-relative path only. Absolute paths (/Users/...) are invalid.

label_status.description: step_inherited_indicator = propagated from expert step alignment; human_adjudicated = independently double-coded; not_coded = no coverage

inherited_from_step.description: Step ID from which this frame's labels were propagated

rubric_behaviors.description: Construct behaviors (B0-B12) present in this frame. B13 is tracked separately. B15/B16/B17 are in process_flags.

b13_status.description: B13 requires transcript. not_measurable_no_transcript when transcript=none.

process_flags.description: Process-layer behavior indicators — NOT construct behaviors. Do not mix into rubric_behaviors.

B15_votat_log.description: Log-derived VOTAT indicator for this session segment

B17_planning.description: Algorithmic planning detection (regex on observer text)

codebook_codes.description: Raw codebook codes from expert narrative, if available

label_source.description: Legacy field preserved for backward compatibility. Use label_status instead.
